name: smart
description: Focused developer workflows, fresh-worker code simplification, content tools, session utilities, and engineering rules.

interface.shortDescription: Run focused developer workflows and content tools.
interface.longDescription: Smart adds semantic commits, fresh-context behavior-preserving code simplification, serial delivery of /to-tickets output through Matt /implement, safe Issue closeout, guided pair-writing, one-cycle TDD, Wiki and weekly report generation, bilingual skills PDFs, statusline setup, and focused engineering utilities.
defaultPrompt: Use $smart:code-simplifier to simplify my recent code changes without changing behavior.
Use $smart:generate-wiki to organize these materials, or $smart:github-skills-pdf to build a bilingual handbook.
Use $smart:my-weekly to summarize my commits for this natural week.
